labelMeaning: Contract backend labels describe observed HTTP evidence or missing results; they do not establish root cause.

boundedTermination.resultIntegrity: The child had already reported its timeout. The harness was allowed to collect its existing failure and all other completed results.

restartAndValidity.firstWorkerShard1Attempt: Sprite rt-pool-6 restarted without an exit status; the runner automatically repeated that shard at the same revision.
restartAndValidity.limitation: The repeated missing-result cases and final 25 failures cannot all be attributed to the first restart. The final full parity gate is not green.

followUpOwnership: The coordinator owns fixture timing and cleanup investigation. No source fix or further parity rerun was performed for this diagnostic.
